notes: DROP: belongs to keyboards (a keyed struck string): «It also marks the 15 keys by letter (C, D, etc.), by number (1–15) and in standard [[musical notation]].» and «When the instrument is moved or stored, the metal rectangle bends down, holding the keys against the strings». Marxophone page (raw wikitext https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Marxophone&action=raw, saved as build/batch-18-pages/marxophone--1.txt; tagged «{{more citations needed|date=June 2009}}»): «The right hand plays the melody strings by depressing spring steel strips that hold small [[lead]] hammers over the strings.» Boundary ruling 3 makes a hammer on a spring strip struck strings unless its fetched source calls the strips keys or the instrument a keyboard zither; this page calls the strips keys (the 15 lettered keys are what the metal rectangle holds against the strings), so the ruling's words send it to keyboards. Had the strips not been keys, the row would still wait: its range, «two [[octave]]s of double melody strings in the [[Key (music)|key]] of C [[major and minor|major]] ([[C (musical note)|middle C]] to C<nowiki>''</nowiki>)», is in the lead paragraph with no citation (range ruling 10), and the bouncing hammer, «A brief stab on a metal strip bounces the hammer off a string pair to produce a single note. Holding the strip down makes the hammer bounce on the double strings, which produces a [[mandolin]]-like [[tremolo]].», is a trait no builder makes (`its own build (a bouncing hammer)` once ranged); the strummed chord strings («The player typically [[Strum|strums]] the chords with the left hand.») are a technique beside the struck melody. The page gives no class (hs none). Reported to the controller as a judgment call; the controller kept the DROP to keyboards on ruling 3's words and flags it for the owner (#88). The other reading: the keys are the spring strips themselves, each pressed straight onto its string with no key lever between finger and hammer, the case ruling 3 otherwise makes struck strings; under that reading the row is WAIT a sourced range.
